title: Order Processing
meta: We review, confirm and process new orders in your store so nothing waits in the queue. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Order processing, handled so nothing waits
overview: We work through the new orders in your store the way you would. Each one is checked for the right address, stock, payment status and shipping choice, then marked ready, held or sent to your fulfilment partner. Problem orders are listed for you with a suggested next step. You get a simple log of orders handled and issues found. This is a fixed amount of processing during the order window, not an ongoing contract.

faq: What do you do with an order that looks wrong?
We hold it, note the reason, such as an incomplete address or a stock problem, and tell you. We do not cancel or refund an order without your approval.
Which platforms and tools do you work with?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix and Squarespace stores, plus common shipping tools. We work as staff in your accounts and never need your passwords.
Do you pack and ship the products?
No. We handle the order side: checking, tagging and passing orders to whoever ships them. Packing and shipping stay with you or your warehouse.
What if my order volume is higher than the package?
Choose the package that fits your count. If your volume is larger, we can quote a custom amount, so you only pay for the orders we handle.
